item.title: ‘I felt tricked’: KSL investigates some misleading claims from those working to repeal Prop 4
item.description: Some paid signature gatherers working to place a repeal of Proposition 4 on the November ballot have misled or withheld information from voters about what the ballot initiative would do, according to a KSL investigation.

item.title: Intermountain Health team helps young woman live beyond her diagnosis
item.description: Once told she wouldn't live past 20, ShayLee Hunter, with the help of an Intermountain Health team, is living life on her own terms and beyond her diagnosis.

item.title: Third Period Storm Dooms Utah Mammoth Against Carolina Hurricanes
item.description: The Utah Mammoth conceded three goals in the third period as the Carolina Hurricanes made a full comeback to win 5-4 on Thursday.

item.title: ‘We know people that are coming here;’ Volunteers walk Jordan River Trail for ‘Point in Time” homelessness count
item.description: The yearly "Point in Time" count aims to figure out where and how federal funding is needed to help the unsheltered population.

item.title: ‘It’s touching’: First of 5 businesses damaged by Main Street fire has now reopened
item.description: White Horse, 325 S. Main, was one of five businesses that had yet to open by the end of 2025, joining Eva, London Belle Supper Club, where the fire originated, Los Tapatios and Whiskey Street Cocktails & Dining.

item.title: ‘High School Musical’ star Lucas Grabeel visits East High School theater class rehearsal
item.description: Lucas Grabeel — best known for his role as Ryan Evans in the "High School Musical" trilogy — dropped in on East High's theater class's rehearsal to offer his insight from his experience in the films.

item.title: We tested 4 popular scam detection apps… here’s what actually worked
item.description: With scammers using AI to trick Utahns out of their money, KSL Investigators put top scam detection apps to the test to find out how well they did against several popular scams.

item.title: The Hat Trick: Carolina Hurricanes Storm Back To Victory As Utah Mammoth Experience Late Colossal Collapse
item.description: Despite outplaying the Carolina Hurricanes for a majority of the contest, the Utah Mammoth experienced a late colossal collapse as the Canes stormed back with three goals in less than 90 seconds to somehow win in regulation.

item.title: ‘Hope Squad’ empowers kids to look out for peers’ mental health
item.description: Hope Squad is now in its 22nd year, supporting students across the state and country and training kids as young as elementary school to serve as peer mentors.

item.title: Utah nurses hold vigil for Minnesota man killed during immigration enforcement protest
item.description: Hundreds of Utah nurses and others joined together Thursday evening to honor Alex Pretti, a 37-year-old intensive care unit nurse who was shot and killed by Border Patrol officers in Minneapolis while protesting immigration enforcement.
